bug_semantics: Authenticated backend users with cms.manage_pages, cms.manage_layouts, or cms.manage_partials can escape the Twig sandbox in System\Twig\SecurityPolicy. The CVE-2024-54149 (GHSA-xhw3-4j3m-hq53) remediation added a class-scoped $blockedMethods list on Eloquent/Halcyon models (save/update/delete/fill/setAttribute/forceDelete/...) and enforced it with instanceof matching on the Twig receiver only. Eloquent Model::__call forwards unknown methods onto the query builder, so equivalent writers never listed on the model (saveQuietly, deleteQuietly, increment, decrement) and accessors that hand out a live builder, connection, relation, or higher-order collection (newQuery, getConnection, getConnectionResolver) still mutate records, run raw SQL/DDL, and write PHP into CMS template code sections. First-party GHSA-8cfw-pcwh-v63w and CVE.org CVE-2026-79774 (VulnCheck CNA, state PUBLISHED) describe this residual bypass; affected range is >=1.2.7,<1.2.13.
flaw_origin: fb88e6fabde3b3278ce1844e581c87dcf7daee22 (2024-10-16, 'Merge commit from fork', author Ben Thomson <git@alfreido.com>, committer GitHub <noreply@github.com>) is the CVE-2024-54149 landing that first wrote the class-scoped $blockedMethods (Controller/DbModel/HalcyonModel/DatasourceInterface/Theme) and the receiver-only checkMethodAllowed() in modules/system/twig/SecurityPolicy.php. Parent 5f53526035ee07317100ced658c469ed3656a0b2 still has that path, but only a global lowercase list (getTwig/addDynamicMethod/insert/update/delete/write) with no DbModel::class grouping and no save()/forceDelete() names. The incomplete per-class list plus receiver-only matching is the residual mechanism this CVE covers. The commit is a GitHub private-fork security merge with a single public parent and no reconstructable second-parent members. Later c231c401c060e03ab497182c300f10f0e6e65e58 added getQuery() and an allowlist, and 49012babed8eca0a3359352942689d20d4b69b13 added session pull; neither closed the forwarding bypass.

reasoning: Vulnerability first: this CVE is the residual Twig-sandbox escape after the 1.2.7 CVE-2024-54149 patch, not the pre-1.2.7 open sandbox. The named sink is a blocklist that does not follow Eloquent __call onto the query builder, leaving saveQuietly/increment/newQuery and connection/collection passthroughs executable from CMS templates. BIC is the smallest public commit that first wrote that incomplete class-scoped policy: fb88e6fab. Parent 5f535260 still has SecurityPolicy.php but only a global name list, so the incomplete per-class mechanism is new at fb88e6fab (parent-tree line absence verified). GitHub security-fork merges often hide private members; fb88e6fab has one parent and ^2 is missing, so it is the smallest surviving public object and is not further decomposable (squash_decomposed=false). Later allowlist/session commits persist the hole but do not introduce it. Tag check: fb88e6fab is in v1.2.7 (start of affected range) and 725bbcda2 lands in v1.2.13 (patched). CVE.org PUBLISHED, so not FALSE_POSITIVE. AI second, BIC-only: fb88e6fab author Ben Thomson / committer GitHub with no AI trailers, so NOT_AI. Claude Fable 5 on 725bbcda2 is remediation-only and does not attribute the introducer.
